state.paragraph: On July 24, 2013, Party B submitted a preliminary indication of interest at an all-cash purchase price of $17.00 to $18.00 per share. Also on July 24, 2013, representatives from Party C called BofA Merrill Lynch and presented an oral preliminary indication of interest at an all-cash purchase price of $15.00 to $17.00 per share.

ledger_rows.Note: Preliminary indication at the round-1 due date; no substantive diligence access yet (management meetings began in August).
Inferred: 20 signers minus Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona (submitted) and Party A (recorded; still negotiating NDA) leaves 16 non-submitters; signing dates unstated, so some may be late entrants.
Preliminary indication submitted after the 07/23/2013 due date; no substantive diligence access yet.
Oral preliminary indication delivered by telephone to BofA Merrill Lynch; written indication followed on 07/25/2013.
Round 2 opened: Special Committee advanced Party A, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona to management meetings and staged diligence, then revised indications.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
